description: Start a booking request for a quote the user has agreed to. Texts a 6-digit code to the user's mobile; then ask the user for it and call confirm_booking. Only after reading the trip and fare back to the user.

mobile.description: Passenger's mobile with country code, e.g. +44 7700 900123

notes.description: Useful for the driver: child seat, mobility needs, large items

terminal_unsure.description: True if the user doesn't know the Gatwick terminal

name: request_booking
title: Request a booking (texts a code)
